WITH baseline_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(modelconf) as baseline_avg
  FROM compliancecase
),
status_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    brokrepstat,
    AVG(modelconf) as status_avg
  FROM compliancecase
  GROUP BY brokrepstat
),
with_baseline AS (
  SELECT 
    status_groups.brokrepstat,
    status_groups.status_avg,
    baseline_calc.baseline_avg,
    status_groups.status_avg - baseline_calc.baseline_avg as diff_from_baseline
  FROM status_groups
  CROSS JOIN baseline_calc
  WHERE status_groups.status_avg > baseline_calc.baseline_avg
),
qualifying_mean_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(status_avg) as mean_of_qualifying
  FROM with_baseline
)
SELECT 
  with_baseline.brokrepstat,
  with_baseline.status_avg,
  with_baseline.diff_from_baseline,
  with_baseline.status_avg / qualifying_mean_calc.mean_of_qualifying as avg_div_mean
FROM with_baseline
CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean_calc
WHERE with_baseline.baseline_avg IS NOT NULL 
  AND qualifying_mean_calc.mean_of_qualifying IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY with_baseline.brokrepstat;
